description: Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority (PPWSA) master plan (2015-2021) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This data shows the Master Plan for the period 2015-2021 in order to allow a sustainable expansion of the Greater Phnom Penh Water Supply System (GPPWSS). The data shows the location of the treatment plant, the location of the water treatment plant in 2018, and the service areas from the year 2015 to 2021. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Development assistance for water and sanitation, SDG6 Clean Water and Sanitation, Urban water supplies and distribution. It offers 9 resource(s) in db_table, geotiff, png, shp, wms. The portal shows 2020-08-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
